 Print The recent Weekend Ka Vaar episodes were quite heavy for ScoutOP and Love Gill as they were called out by host Rohit Shetty for their closeness. Things got heated when Scout's girlfriend Kaashvi Hiranandani appeared on WKV stage and confronted him over his closeness with Love. She also slammed Love accused her of trapping Scout. After the episode, Love emotionally broke down and was severely affected by Kaashvi's words. The next day, she confronted Scout about why he did not stand for her when his girlfriend accused him of emotionally manipulating and trapping him. She also opened up about how comments made by his girlfriend, Kaashvi Hiranandani, affected her public image. She was seen indirectly addressing her past controversy with Gurpreet Ghuggi . While talking to ScoutOp about the matter, the discussion also reminded viewers of the reported Rs 5 crore settlement controversy involving Gurpreet Ghuggi. Love gets emotional talking about her past controversy
 Talking about the entire incident, Love said, "Maine pehle bhi bataya hai, main bahut mushkil se nikli hoon. Main ek mahine pehle in sab cheezon se bahar nikal ke aayi hoon." While, Love did not directly mention the controversy, her comments sparked speculation that she could be referring to the controversial dispute involving Ghuggi. She slammed Scout for not defending her in front of Kaashvi and letting her comment on her character. Love said, "Jab woh bol rahi thi, tumhaari girlfriend, ki trap fasa rahi tab tune us cheez ko clarity kyu nahi di?" She blamed ScoutOP for allegedly “ruining” her career by discussing his feelings about her with Yung DSA. She questioned him for mentioning the gestures he had made on the grass and asked why she was she not informed about the same. For the uninitiated, the controversy started when a Canada-based YouTuber made claims about Love Gill and Gurpreet Ghuggi, who appeared together in the Punjabi film Furlow. The YouTuber alleged that the two were in a relationship, that Love had become pregnant. He further alleged that a Rs 5 crore settlement was made to keep the matter private. However, these claims have not been verified. Ghuggi dismissed the allegations, stating that they were “completely false and fabricated. ” On the other hand, Love Gill also refuted the rumours. In May 2026, she reportedly responded to the online trolling through an Instagram Story, asking those who kept questioning her about Ghuggi to reach out to him directly if they wanted to know about his well-being.
